edges.reason: msg.sender is read and returned by _msgSender.
Caller identity flows into the transfer core, which gates logic on owner() and _pair.
transfer calls _msgSender to obtain the sender.
transferFrom calls _msgSender for spender identity.
approve calls _msgSender for the owner argument.
openTrading onlyOwner modifier invokes _msgSender.
renounceOwnership onlyOwner modifier invokes _msgSender.
transfer forwards to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer at the end.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard requests values from _getValues.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues calls _getRate.
_reflectFee inside the transfer path decreases _rTotal.
_transferStandard writes sender/recipient balances in _rOwned.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth on the contract token balance before updating balances.
_transfer pushes ETH out via sendETHToFee, an external value transfer.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee executes _taxWallet.transfer.
_taxWallet.transfer hands control to an external address that can re-enter _transfer.
Router swap callback can re-enter the transfer path before state is settled.
manualSwap is tax-wallet gated and calls swapTokensForEth.
manualSend is tax-wallet gated and calls sendETHToFee.
manualSwap compares msg.sender against _taxWallet.
manualSend compares msg.sender against _taxWallet.
openTrading is guarded by the _owner check in onlyOwner.
openTrading calls router addLiquidityETH with the contract balance.
openTrading calls factory createPair.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the liquidity deadline in openTrading.
_transfer reads the _oracle contract reference for the oracle amount check.
The oracle instance is dereferenced to perform amount().
Oracle.amount() is an external call made from within the transfer path.

rAmount local is subtracted from the sender's reflection balance.

_tax is consumed by _getValues/_getTValues.
_router is used for WETH lookup, approval and the swap call.

transferFrom reads _allowances to subtract the spent amount.
balanceOf reads _rOwned for the queried account.

_owner is compared against from and to inside _transfer.
renounceOwnership overwrites the _owner state variable.
